invariants.description: total Ca (free + buffered, four compartments: the shell V_shell = A_mem d_shell, the bulk, pre-ER and ER) changes exactly by the integrated Ca influx of the connected channel (harness: the L-type Ca channel at a fixed V): volume-weighted total - total0 = integral j_Ca_L dt. Tolerance: 1e-6 of the integral plus 100 x the solver resolution of the total.
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(((V_shell*(Cai + CaB_Cai) + Vol*((1 - V_shell/Vol - c_ER - c_ER_pre)*(Ca_bulk + CaB_Ca_bulk) + c_ER_pre*(Ca_ER_pre + CaB_Ca_ER_pre) + c_ER*Ca_ER)) - (V_shell*(Cai + CaB_Cai) + Vol*((1 - V_shell/Vol - c_ER - c_ER_pre)*(Ca_bulk + CaB_Ca_bulk) + c_ER_pre*(Ca_ER_pre + CaB_Ca_ER_pre) + c_ER*Ca_ER))[0]) - np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(cal__j_Ca_L[1:] + cal__j_Ca_L[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) <= 1e-6*np.max(np.abs(np.concatenate(([0.0], np.cumsum(0.5*(cal__j_Ca_L[1:] + cal__j_Ca_L[:-1])*np.diff(t)))))) + 100*1e-8*np.max(np.abs(V_shell*(Cai + CaB_Cai) + Vol*((1 - V_shell/Vol - c_ER - c_ER_pre)*(Ca_bulk + CaB_Ca_bulk) + c_ER_pre*(Ca_ER_pre + CaB_Ca_ER_pre) + c_ER*Ca_ER)))

invariants.description: the channel moves Ca (the harness exercises j_Ca_in): total Ca changes
invariants.expr: abs((V_shell*(Cai + CaB_Cai) + Vol*((1 - V_shell/Vol - c_ER - c_ER_pre)*(Ca_bulk + CaB_Ca_bulk) + c_ER_pre*(Ca_ER_pre + CaB_Ca_ER_pre) + c_ER*Ca_ER))[-1] - (V_shell*(Cai + CaB_Cai) + Vol*((1 - V_shell/Vol - c_ER - c_ER_pre)*(Ca_bulk + CaB_Ca_bulk) + c_ER_pre*(Ca_ER_pre + CaB_Ca_ER_pre) + c_ER*Ca_ER))[0]) > 0
